allocationId.description: Printable ASCII without spaces, so 128 characters is 128 UTF-8 bytes on every reader.

resourceId.description: Printable ASCII without spaces, so 128 characters is 128 UTF-8 bytes on every reader.

runtimeInstanceId.description: Absent for a process that is not InferWeave's.

modelId.description: Printable ASCII without spaces, so 128 characters is 128 UTF-8 bytes on every reader.

placementClass.description: Absent on a foreign-process allocation, which is not InferWeave's and is not classified; otherwise absent means normal.

intended.description: Whether the allocation is pinned to this GPU. Absent: not reported.

observedAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp (producer clock; display only).

meta.description: At most 8 string pairs; never arguments, environment or secrets.
